faq.q: Can I make a Facebook ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, share your idea in one sentence and choose a square image or a Reels-style clip. The credit cost shows before you start.

faq.q: Which Facebook placements can I make ads for?
faq.a: Make a square still to crop for the Feed, or a 9:16 clip for Reels and Stories. Pick the file the placement asks for.

faq.q: Do I need to book a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. The image or clip is built from your own product photo, so there is no shoot day and no wait for footage. Start another job when you need a new angle.
Yes. Run another job from the same photo with a different idea and compare the results in Ads Manager. You do not reshoot or pay a second creator.

faq.q: Where do I add the headline and price?
faq.a: Add the primary text, headline, price and call to action in Ads Manager after download, so they stay easy to change for each audience.

faq.q: Does the file include sound and captions?
faq.a: No. Add any sound and caption text in Ads Manager or an editor after you download the file.
Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product, with a little space around it. This keeps the item clear when Meta crops or adds controls.

faq.q: Do I need to label the ad as AI-made?
faq.a: Meta's rules can change by market and creative. Check the current AI-label and ad review requirements in Ads Manager before launch.
